Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name containing 'histone deacetylase 6' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
